Name: Purple Museum Reward Furniture
Author: joyous1ariella
Description:
I love purple. I especially love the color of the "Standing Geode" (the crystal rock formation thing) you get from donating minerals to the museum. So I was disappointed when the other museum reward items didn't match!

This mod recolors the following two items:
"Crystal Chair" based on the "Standing Geode" colors.
"Singing Stone" based on a mix of the "Standing Geode" and "Small Crystal" colors.

*****[i]This is not compatibile with any mods that change the Craftables.xnb or furniture.xnb files!*****

[/i]I may add more purple furniture in the future :3

Enjoy!
-Ariella

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Installation:
[list=1]
[*]Navigate to your Stardew Valley game folder and go to the Content-->TileSheets folder (mine is at C:\GOG Games\Stardew Valley\Content\TileSheets)
[*]MAKE A COPY OF Craftables.xnb AND furniture.xnb FOR BACKUP!
[*]Extract the .rar to that folder using [url=http://www.rarlab.com/download.htm]WinRar[/url] or similar program and overwrite the file.
[/list]
